QuestInfo.name: Creature Research (Combat)
QuestInfo.0: #p9120024# from Showa Town is doing research on rare and powerful creatures, but he can't collect the data alone. You should help out.
QuestInfo.1: #p9120024# is almost done with his research, but doesn't have enough combat data. He requested that you defeat one #o9400008#.
QuestInfo.2: After you defeated the requested monster and provided the data, #p9120024# returned to his research.

0.0: That's not right... Oh, you there. I need an assistant for my research. Are you looking for work?

yes.0: I've been researching rare creatures, but I'm missing some final data.
yes.1: I'd like your help to gather it.
yes.2: The work is difficult but necessary. I need you to defeat a powerful monster.
yes.3: I need data on #o9400008#. Defeat one and get back to me.
yes.4: Good luck. I'll give you something good when you bring back the data.

no.0: It's not anything scary. Come back if you change your mind.

1.0: You returned faster than I expected. Now let me see the data. Yes, this is it!
1.1: Here's the reward I promised. It's as precious as the data you brought.
1.2: I've got to integrate this data into my research. Bye.

mob.0: To get the data I need, you'll need to defeat one #o9400008#. I'm counting on you.
